description: ZP-MC-PLG-13M8 is the drawing identifier for connector sealing component in AutomationDirect's ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors collection. A connector sealing component forms part of the selected connector assembly boundary. Its presence alone does not establish the protection of an assembled installation.

For example, in a field connector assembly where the selected seal must match the adjoining parts, use the ZP-MC-PLG-13M8 reference to coordinate seal seating, mating parts and assembly access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors/ZP-MC-PLG-13M8.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
